name: Verify user requests details for a specific ticket
objective: Validate that a user can ask about a specific ticket and receive its detailed status and assignment information.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open. User has an open ticket INC-12345.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon on the home page
Verify the assistant displays details for the specific ticket
steps.expectedResult: The assistant shows ticket details including status, description, assigned team, and last update
